revised_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: TripPet iOS mailbox page decorative cutout, perched butterfly that will sit on top of a cream rural mailbox and flap via SwiftUI transform animation
Primary request: Create one prominent, opaque butterfly illustration designed as a game/app art asset. The butterfly is perched/resting on a mailbox, wings open and slightly raised as if ready to flap. It must read clearly at small mobile size.
Subject: a single friendly butterfly with a small fuzzy body, visible antennae, bold readable wing silhouette, wings angled in a gentle three-quarter view. Make the butterfly body and wings visually solid and opaque, not translucent, not see-through, no glassy or ghostly effect.
Style/medium: warm hand-painted watercolor plus colored-pencil texture matching a cozy travel-pet storybook app, with crisp inked edges and polished mobile game asset readability.
Composition/framing: centered full subject, generous padding, square image. Pose suitable for sitting on the curved top of a mailbox; the lower body should feel like it can touch/rest on a surface. Wings should be open enough to animate by subtle rotation/scale.
Lighting/mood: warm late-afternoon sunlight, cheerful, lively, inviting.
Color palette: more saturated and prominent than the mailbox background: teal blue wing fields, honey yellow and warm coral accents, dark sage/sepia outlines, cream highlights. Avoid pale washed-out low-opacity colors.
Materials/textures: hand-painted paper texture inside the butterfly only; crisp dark outline and solid paint coverage.
Background: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Constraints: The butterfly itself must be fully opaque and non-transparent. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the butterfly. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no props, no text, no watermark. Crisp subject edges separated from the background.
Avoid: translucent wings, faded watercolor wash, low contrast, tiny unreadable details, realistic photo style, extra flowers, mailbox, envelope, animals, people, text.
